description: Analyzes up to 100 recent reviews (~30-90 seconds). Bright Data can take longer. Use only when Amazon review-sample analysis is explicitly requested; use `check_product_trust` for an existing evidence score or `compare_products` to rank listings. On-demand sampling without your cookie; reviews are sorted within the returned sample, but the provider does not guarantee the listing's newest 100. May trigger paid Bright Data collection and writes a seven-day analysis cache. force_refresh bypasses that cache and may start another paid scrape. A later explicit call without force_refresh resumes a pending job without a new scrape. Heuristics do not prove authenticity.

force_refresh.description: Bypass the seven-day cache; may start a new paid review scrape. Leave false to reuse cache or resume a pending job.

description: Return the GoBuy Evidence Score (0-100) and complete signal breakdown for a single retailer listing on Amazon, Walmart, Target, or Best Buy. This is the GPV-1 gate evaluator: score >= 55 PASS, 35-54 FLAG, < 35 or not-indexed BLOCK. The returned verdict is an evidence tier (strong/moderate/weak), not a computed GPV-1 checkout decision. Use this for individual product lookups. To compare and rank multiple products, use `compare_products` instead. Use `analyze_reviews` only for explicitly requested Amazon review-sample analysis; this lookup never fetches reviews. Read-only — does not modify any state or place orders. Scores describe available marketplace records, not product quality or purchase recommendations.
